g.text: V1.0 | 12 V DC input / 3.3 V logic | 2026-10-13
Connected dots = joined nets. Crossing lines without a dot are NOT connected. Same net names connect across sheets.
Power-up: R11 holds E high; R12/R13 hold S0/S1 low.
Disable E before changing the selected UART channel.
Connector RX/TX are from the SENSOR side. Each RX pull-up is after its series resistor.
